content: 主帖不放链接，链接放在第一条自我回复中，避免减少触达。 主帖保持独立价值，评论里再放链接。
author: earnthread
notes: 最常见建议。来源还提到 big_sensei、AlexFinn。

content: 长期链接放在个人资料的 Bio 或 Website 字段，也可以用 Link-in-bio。 这个位置不挂在单条帖子上，是目前比较稳的放法。
author: Buffer
notes: 安全位置，不附加于单个帖子。

content: 优先文本、图片、视频和线程。链接只作补充。 Premium 账号发带链接的帖子表现更好；非 Premium 的链接帖参与可能接近于零。
author: Buffer

content: 把链接放在第一条回复，并写上 link below，或直接把链接贴在那里。 这样是把人推进评论区，而不是在主帖里硬塞链接。
author: big_sensei
notes: 同样的做法也出现在 AlexFinn 的帖子里。

content: 2026 年中后期的数据里，链接惩罚可能已经减少或取消。Elon 说过超过一年没有罚；OpenTweet 的数据里，带链接的帖子并不更差。 仍然建议自己测，并优先用回复放链接。
author: OpenTweet

content: 主帖写有价值的内容，第一条自我回复里再放链接。 这是目前被提到最多的稳妥位置。
author: X Community

content: 长期链接放在简介，或置顶帖。 适合一直要留着的地址，不适合只发一次的活动。
author: X Community

content: 自己建 GitHub 仓库、Chrome 扩展、NPM 包，再从这些地方链回站点。 这是在做自己的高权重资产，不是去借别人的评论区。
author: AINoSleep

content: 用用户会问的方式写内容，让 AI 回答时引用你的页面。 外链和被 AI 引用可以一起做。
author: Wolong

content: Posts with links tend to reach fewer people on X. So: • Write the post so it stands alone • Put the link in the first reply • Only say \link below\" if the post needs it Your best post shouldn't depend on a click to be useful."
author: EarnThread

content: One mistake that could be hurting your reach on X 👇 If you’re a creator, avoid putting a direct link to a private platform in your bio. ... Use a redirect link like Linkme.
author: Jeremy

content: X's open-sourced ranking code shows that a post with an outside link in the body loses about 30 to 50% of its reach. Post the words on their own and put the link in the first reply.
author: Matthew Myers

content: X’s algorithm is open source. Here’s what its ranking weights reveal about growing here 👇 Click an external link: +0.2 ...
author: Dharmesh P

content: External Link Suppression Bypass: Keep external URLs completely out of the main post body to avoid the 30%–50% reach penalty, placing links strictly in the first self-reply.
author: Ashwin

content: adding 5 internal links to a page sounds too simple to move rankings until you see a page jump from page 2 to page 1 without a single new backlink
author: Sarvesh Shrivastava

content: To maintain your post's reach on X
source: keep URLs out of the main content. Share the value first
author: then drop any links in a reply.

content: I’ve noticed many of you are creating great content but not getting the reach you deserve. ... put links in replies.

content: Outside links are completely deprioritized in the code. If you HAVE to include links
source: reply to your original post and put it in the follow up
